Subject: Vendor onboarding: Insurance declaration & claims history

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist — attaching the high-level insurance summary we typically provide for integrations.

Attached: Zenith_Insurance_Summary.pdf (declarations page, general liability limits, umbrella)

Quick notes:
- We carry $2M per occurrence / $4M aggregate GL and a $5M umbrella.
- Our COI usually lists clients as certificate holders; we can add Redwood as additional insured if required.

Question: you mentioned a 5-year claims history and an endorsement naming Redwood as additional insured with waiver of subrogation — can you confirm the exact language Redwood needs so we can get this routed to our carrier?

We also have a short vendor risk worksheet that might help speed review if you want it filled out.

Best,
Samantha Ellis
Head of Partnerships, Zenith Data, Inc.
Samantha.ellis@zenith-data.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Insurance declaration & claims history

Hi Samantha — thanks for sending the summary. A couple of specific asks to get Zenith activated and the PO issued: 

1) Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing limits you listed and naming Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured (CG 20 26 or equivalent).
2) Endorsement or endorsement-ready text confirming waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood.
3) Loss runs (claims history) for the past 5 years in PDF form. We need these to complete our risk review.
4) Please confirm the carrier NAIC number and policy effective/expiration dates.

If you prefer, fill out this short vendor risk worksheet and upload it to our onboarding folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/ONBOARDING/zenith-risk-worksheet — that will speed legal and finance sign-off.

Operational note: once we have the endorsement + loss runs we can move to issue a PO (reference DEAL-7642). If anything will be delayed, pls flag and we can consider a conditional PO with acceptance clauses.

Cc-ing Lauren (procurement) for endorsement language and Mina (finance) for PO timing.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Vendor Manager | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Logan — attaching a combined file with the declarations page and our most recent loss run.

Attached: declarations_and_loss_run_2027-07.pdf (Declarations + loss run)

Two quick items:
- Our broker indicated the carrier will need exact endorsement wording. If you can share the endorsement template you prefer we can pass it to our carrier.
- We prefer not to delay integration; is a conditional PO acceptable while we obtain the formal endorsement? If Redwood requires the endorsement prior to PO, please confirm and we will prioritize.

Thanks,
Samantha
[Attachment: declarations_and_loss_run_2027-07.pdf (PDF)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ellis <samantha.ellis@zenith-data.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Insurance declaration & claims history

Hi Samantha — welcome. For clarity, please have your carrier/ broker issue an endorsement with the following pieces exactly as written below. We need the carrier to confirm these items on the endorsement page (not just the COI):

1) Additional Insured: Redwood Inference, Inc., 1234 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103.
2) Waiver of Subrogation: Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc., specific to claims arising out of services provided under the agreement.
3) Primary & Non-Contributory wording: The endorsement should state coverage is primary and non-contributory with respect to Redwood Inference.

If the carrier cannot provide CG 20 26 exactly, equivalent language is acceptable but we need the exact text included in the endorsement.

Please also confirm whether there are any AI/ML product exclusions on the policy — if the policy excludes AI-related liability we will need to discuss with Legal.

Once we have the endorsement and loss runs, Finance will queue the PO. Mina — can you confirm expected PO issuance timeline after endorsement acceptance?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: endorsement-template.txt]

Mina, please advise if Finance can issue a conditional PO (PO-7642-PENDING-END) to allow engineering access while the carrier processes the endorsement.
